Motion Studio · 14 November 2026 · English

Restore CI. Verify the arcade.

Pages publishing is enabled and its existing workflow passed. The arcade theme is formatted, integrated with current main, and checked at real desktop and mobile sizes.

Issue #78 · PR #75

What changed and why

The main software checks already passed. The separate Pages deployment failed with HTTP 404 because Pages was disabled. Enabled its existing GitHub Actions source. A deploy-only retry then had no artifact; rerunning the complete workflow rebuilt it and deployed successfully. The site returned HTTP 200.

PR #75's approved CI run failed the same Prettier check on Ubuntu, Windows and macOS: directory.css, mole.css and runner.css. Applied the formatter, preserving all gates and OS lanes, and merged main's static Pages build into the PR branch. No dependency or distributable was added.

The original PR supplies the ink/lime directory, setup styling, and optional hit/coin effects. Review corrected low-contrast lime copy, scoreboard labels and Maze buttons; removed Dodgeball overrides that assumed a light scoreboard; and wrapped shared game navigation at narrow widths while retaining 44px link targets. The particle regression checks repeated render ticks and animation cleanup. Game scoring, camera acquisition and identity contracts remain unchanged.

Actual verification

Passed locally: pnpm check (932 Vitest tests, 314 pytest tests, contracts, types, lint, formatting and repository conventions); pnpm build (all seven entries and emitted references); pnpm build:pages (all five entries); pnpm verify:pages (four rehearsal starts at desktop and mobile, under the repository path).

Chromium 157.0.4341.42: 15 page/viewport cases across the directory and four games at 1440×1000, 390×844 and 320×844. All 12 game cases started a rehearsal round. Every final page fit its viewport; no uncaught page errors and no camera starts occurred. Reduced-motion CSS returned none for the particle and stage-flash animations.

The immutable main baseline also ran at all three measured widths. It recorded 0 setup-page overflow case(s); the final theme recorded zero. An initial harness setup error was corrected before accepting these results: viewport width is now explicitly set and asserted, and reduced motion uses browser media emulation.

Measured contrast ratios: muted copy 5.26:1; dark scoreboard labels 8.87:1; Maze action 5.59:1; primary score and Start action 13.01:1.

Limits and reproducibility

Local Windows used Node 24.16.0, pnpm 11.25.0 and an isolated Python 3.12.16 environment. Hosted CI pins Node 24.21.0 and validates three operating systems. Builds, browser checks and tests ran serially. Physical cameras, GPU inference, participant accuracy and motion-to-display latency were not tested. The existing large Runner bundle warning remains.

Run node scripts/verify-ui-polish.mjs --before and then without --before for the English screenshots, rehearsal starts, layout, contrast samples and reduced-motion checks. Run pnpm check, pnpm build, pnpm build:pages and pnpm verify:pages for their separate gates. PR #67 needs its own conflict resolution and combined ownership/recovery review before merging.

This report embeds its CSS and screenshots and needs no network to render. Optional source links are external. No participant images, credentials, local device identifiers or private participant data are included.
